headline: South African Manufacturing Sentiment Remains Negative for Fifth Month
summary: South Africa's factory sentiment stayed muted for a fifth consecutive month due to rising purchasing-price pressures and weaker business expectations.
why: Manufacturing PMI metrics provide insights into industrial output and broader macroeconomic growth in Africa's most industrialized economy.

impacts.name: South Africa
impacts.why: Persistent weakness in manufacturing sentiment reflects economic headwind.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
